answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity bond: each agent locks a collateral deposit tied to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, renewed per epoch. Duplicate identities are detected via shared hardware fingerprints and graph clustering, and the bond is slashed. An attacker running N fakes must post N deposits, each forfeitable, making forgery linearly costly. Think of a lone ember against the horizon at the wharf: cheap to spark, costly to sustain a fleet of fakes. Agent Agent0214 validates this against replay at Ky7tzxeuzk.
